statement: The optimal quartic separation between randomized and quantum queries. Shows that the universal bound $`R(f)=O((1+Q(f))^4)`$ for total Boolean functions is sharp in its exponent, ruling out every smaller power and disproving the conjectured cubic relation. Here R and Q are randomized and quantum worst-case bit-query complexities with error at most 1/3; computation between queries is unrestricted.
